title: chAndogyopaniSad with zaMkarabhASya
[GRETIL-Version vom 12.3.2020]

oṃ sāmavedīyā chāndogyopaniṣat
atha prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ
om ity etad akṣaram udgītham upāsīta || ChUp_1,1.1 ||
oṃ iti etat akṣaram ity avadhāraṇārthaḥ | udgīthāvayavatvāt || ChUpBh_1,1.1 ||
tasya haitasyākṣarasyopavyākhyānam || ChUp_1,1.2 ||
tasya ha etasya akṣarasya upavyākhyānaṃ kriyate || ChUpBh_1,1.2 ||
eṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ pṛthivī rasaḥ || ChUp_1,1.3 ||
